summary: Increment 1 (Seam 2). Forward-only divergence repair: re-issue lifecycle_approve_onboarding so onboarding-approved jobs are created through the canonical single-source engine (lifecycle_materialize_jobs), which produces statutory deadlines. The live function had drifted back to a pre-consolidation inline body that created jobs with automation_source='template', no periods, and NO deadlines. git-HEAD 20260629091343 already contained this fix but it never took effect live.

problem.live_symptom: Onboarding-approved jobs land with filing_deadline NULL and no rows in public.deadlines. Verified live 2026-07-24: 6 onboarding applications' jobs all have automation_source='template', period_label='2026', filing_deadline NULL.
problem.root_cause: live-vs-git divergence — the live lifecycle_approve_onboarding (def hash 5a7c9aa0c10beddb9a80394a2590e2a5) runs an inline INSERT INTO jobs (...) instead of calling the canonical engine. Confirmed byte-diff vs git-HEAD 20260629091343: identical everywhere except the IF v_onboarding.quote_id block.
problem.engine_decision: lifecycle_materialize_jobs -> lifecycle_upsert_job_with_deadlines -> calculate_deadline is the confirmed single source of truth (all other live paths use it; src/test/regression/job-creation-single-source.test.ts enforces it). The canonical_spine_v1 trigger engine is intentionally inert (nothing creates canonical_spine_v1 jobs).

expected_objects.object: function public.lifecycle_approve_onboarding body PERFORMs public.lifecycle_materialize_jobs and contains NO 'INSERT INTO jobs'
expected_objects.verify_via: catalog_functions name_like 'lifecycle_approve_onboarding' include_source: assert definition contains 'lifecycle_materialize_jobs(' and does NOT contain 'INSERT INTO jobs'. Record the new definition_hash (expect != 5a7c9aa0c10beddb9a80394a2590e2a5).

expected_objects.object: A newly approved onboarding produces public.deadlines rows with non-null due_date for its jobs
expected_objects.verify_via: Behavioural: approve a real onboarding (company with year_end_month/day, or an SA individual) via approve_onboarding_transactional, then db_select public.deadlines filtered to the created job_ids — expect statutory rows with due_date set (company_accounts, corporation_tax(+payment), confirmation_statement, vat_return, self_assessment, payroll per the quote lines).
